name: SweetHome3D
description: Sweet Home 3D Online is the browser edition of Sweet Home 3D, an interior design application for drawing a house plan, arranging furniture on it and viewing the result in 3D. Homes are created, opened and saved directly in the browser and stored on the container.

notes.text: Both OS options come from the same script: pick Debian or Alpine in the container OS menu, or pass var_os=alpine for an unattended install.
Upstream publishes no binaries for the web edition, so the install transpiles it from the Subversion sources with JSweet and Ant. Expect 10-20 minutes, and keep the full Ant log if it fails.
The Ant build is the memory peak and it is identical on both systems. If the transpiler is killed on Alpine, raise the container RAM above the 1 GB default and run the update to rebuild.
Sweet Home 3D Online has no authentication and its save endpoint does not validate the file name it is given. Keep the container on a trusted network and do not expose port 80 to the internet.
Saved homes live in /opt/sweethome3d_data, reached through the data symlink the application requires, so they survive an update.
